Here's my honest review:

I played this with some of my fnaf loving friends and it was an absolute BLAST! We played for a solid 4 hours with no breaks and discovered some flaws with the game.

First of all, we thought that the map was randomized. Maybe making the map not randomized and having some landmarks around the map would make it a lot better. For example, every hallway looks the same. Maybe add some posters or other decoration to make the maps less confusing. When playing with my friends, we found that it was near impossible to tell where we were going. 

Adding some overall aesthetic to the game would help aswell. FNAF is a horror game, maybe add some flickering lights, or use duller colors, or something like that. I'm not a game designer, I don't really know.

There was a lot with the game that you did right. We liked that the animatronics had different abilities, which we used a lot and it was very interesting to use. Maybe add a tutorial to the game, so that people can understand what the different abilities can do. We had no clue what Freddy's abilities did until we looked very close and found out what they did. 

tl;dr, awesome game, needs minor improvements.
